issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other: Sewer Fund 16,373.00 + Sewer Reserve Fund 63.79
issues.issue: Exhibit A has no charges-for-services line, so the sewer funds' Local Receipts: Other are probably sewer user charges (60% of business-type receipts are in other). The label is a context label, so the context check should settle it. The same applies to detail[17] and detail[19].
